pages.title: Storage Grows Up
pages.text: Expand storage while preserving contents; a normal Stack Upgrade adds capacity and tape supports later filled-container relocation.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Basic Tier upgrades supported vanilla storage; copper/iron/gold/diamond/netherite conversions expand slots according to installed recipes. Packing Tape relocates filled storage under native rules.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Chests, barrels and shulkers have native tiers and compatible upgrades; basic/further tier conversions preserve real contents.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Tape packs filled storage for native relocation; paintbrush/decoration table alter appearance within supported materials/blocks.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Storage Stack raises per-slot limits; tiers/conversions need no every-tier checklist. Downgrades deliberately reduce limits.
